The '''2017–18 [[Super League Greece]]''', or ''Souroti Super League'' for sponsorship reasons,<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.novasports.gr/podosfairo/ellada/super-league/article/332104/perase-i-horigia-souroti-souper-lig|title=Πέρασε η χορηγία, "Σουρωτή Σούπερ Λιγκ"|publisher=novasports.gr|date=23 June 2017|lang=el|archive-date=12 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180612142121/http://www.novasports.gr/podosfairo/ellada/super-league/article/332104/perase-i-horigia-souroti-souper-lig|url-status=dead}}</ref> was the 82nd season of the highest tier in league of [[Football in Greece|Greek]] [[Association football|football]] and the 12th under its current name. The season started in August 2017 and ended in May 2018. The league comprises fourteen teams from the 2016–17 season and two promoted from the [[2016–17 Football League (Greece)|2016–17 Football League]].

On 12 March 2018, the Super League Greece was suspended by the Greek government until further notice after the president of [[PAOK FC|PAOK]], [[Ivan Savvidis]], had stormed onto the pitch with a revolver during the match between PAOK and [[AEK Athens F.C.|AEK Athens]] played the previous day.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/43369490|title=Greek Superleague suspended after PAOK Salonika president invades pitch with gun|website=bbc.com|date=12 March 2018}}</ref> The suspension was lifted on 27 March. PAOK was deducted 3 points and AEK was awarded 3 points for the incident.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.ekathimerini.com/sports/227200/long-overdue-decision-deducts-points-from-paok-slaps-three-year-ban-on-savvidis/|title=Long-overdue decision deducts points from PAOK, slaps three-year ban on Savvidis|publisher=Kathimerini|date=29 March 2018}}</ref>

Contrary to the previous seasons, the playoffs for the Champions League and Europa League spots were removed, with qualification based solely on finishing position.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.superleaguegreece.net/el/news/latest-news/show/apofaseis-gs-kai-ds-1882017|title=Αποφάσεις Γ.Σ. και Δ.Σ. 18/8/2017"|publisher=superleaguegreece.net|date=18 August 2017|lang=el|archive-date=14 October 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181014204053/http://www.superleaguegreece.net/el/news/latest-news/show/apofaseis-gs-kai-ds-1882017|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Teams==
Two teams were relegated from the [[2016–17 Super League Greece|2016–17 season]]. [[Iraklis F.C. (Thessaloniki)|Iraklis]] and [[Veria F.C.|Veria]] played in [[Football League (Greece)|Football League]] for the 2017–18 season.

Two teams were promoted from the [[2016–17 Football League (Greece)|2016–17 Football League]], [[Apollon Smyrnis F.C.|Apollon Smyrnis]] and [[PAS Lamia 1964|Lamia]], the latter for which it was their debut season in the highest division of Greek football.
